card.title: Choose Me
card.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take me as your expedition photographer instead of Martin. I speak French.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're crossing a desert, not interviewing people.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your sponsor's French. I could send them updates they can actually use.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want their logo visible in every picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it on the water flask. Martin photographs untouched wilderness; I'll make sure yours looks generously funded.

mechanism: A positions their skills and sponsor responsiveness as reasons to choose them over the established photographer.
confusable: Unlike generic self-promotion, B's requirements must change A's comparative pitch.
comparison: D10-b promises branding where a rival prefers wilderness purity; D10-a rebuilds a birthday around the competing concert's appeal.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
